run_experiment_with_config: run a PyTorch experiment by passing a config file via the --config flag
run_experiment_on_gpu: run a PyTorch experiment on a specific GPU device using the --device flag
run_experiment_on_cpu: run a PyTorch experiment on the CPU by omitting the --device flag
review_main_entrypoint: review the main entrypoint function that validates arguments and delegates to experiment.run_program
refactor_config_flags: refactor the absl flags to add additional configuration options for the experiment launcher
